THE MESA REPOSITORIES

Which MESA project do you need?

Start with Core to add memory to your application. Data and Law serve the legal example; QA and E2E Certification test the projects. You do not need to install all five.

Core connects your documents to your application.

The legal example adds Data and Law.

Data prepares legal sources; Core stores and searches them; Law provides the legal workspace. This is one application of MESA, not a required installation chain.

  1. MESA DataPrepare the source
  2. MESA CoreStore and search
  3. MESA LawUse it in legal work

Open the repository you need.

MESA Core

Stores and searches your documents.

Input: your source text. Output: matching passages with their source.

Start here to build with MESA.
Read the guide →GitHub ↗

MESA Data

Prepares legal source documents.

Input: reviewed legal sources. Output: a versioned data release for Core.

Optional for your own documents.
Read the guide →GitHub ↗

MESA Law

Uses Core in a legal application.

Adds case files, documents and review screens around the memory service.

Under development; live integration is not yet verified.
Read the guide →GitHub ↗

MESA QA

Tests memory behavior.

Checks saving, updates, deletion and behavior after a restart.

A test tool, not part of every query.
Read the guide →GitHub ↗

E2E Certification

Checks a complete test setup.

Collects evidence across projects and checks required pass/fail conditions.

No completed production approval.
Read the guide →GitHub ↗
